versions.changelog:
Obsidian Daily Note Writer v1.0.0

- Initial release enabling structured writing of user-supplied content into Obsidian daily notes.
- Supports auto-setup of vault path and daily notes directory via config file, environment variable, or user prompt.
- Only triggers on explicit user instructions; never auto-activates or assumes context.
- Prepends each entry with current time as H3 heading; strictly uses verbatim user content and strong separators.
- Handles images (saves to attachments, inserts obsidian link) and attempts to extract titles for pasted URLs.
- Ensures strict formatting, separation, and a consistent, user-oriented workflow.
